provenance.rule: The supplied reviewed commit is unavailable locally; this contract is grounded in the current tree and preserves all accepted supplied constraints.

generic_secret_storage_reuse.reason: Generic encrypted secret persistence is suitable only behind a dedicated wrapper that freezes service isolation, key namespace isolation, index/rotation-inventory isolation and fail-closed semantics. This is storage reuse, not Catalog custody reuse.
generic_secret_storage_reuse.storage_key_namespace: AccountGenesis wrapper MUST prefix and validate AccountGenesis-only opaque slots
generic_secret_storage_reuse.HWID_binding: Master-key record binds the current HWID digest; mismatch fails closed
generic_secret_storage_reuse.master_key_ownership: Per service namespace; storage encryption owner, never authority-key lifecycle owner

index_behavior.role: Operational rotation inventory; not trust authority
index_behavior.loss_or_corruption: Must not establish authenticity or freshness. An incomplete or wrong-domain index MUST make affected master-key rotation fail closed before destructive master-key replacement.
index_behavior.cross_authority_risk: The current index records storage_key without service identity. A shared index lets service-local lookup return None for a foreign entry and current rotate_master_key then unregister that entry.
index_behavior.current_generic_guarantee: NOT_PROVIDED: the AccountGenesis wrapper/future implementation MUST validate exclusive inventory before rotation

generic_secret_storage_reuse.rotation_behavior: NON_TRANSACTIONAL: current rotate_master_key stores the new master key before re-encrypting all indexed secrets; the wrapper MUST NOT claim transactional safety
generic_secret_storage_reuse.failure_semantics: Native backend/HWID/decryption/write failures MUST make substrate unavailable; never regenerate enrolled authority secrets or accept partial rotation
generic_secret_storage_reuse.future_implementation_requirement: Before replacing the master key, validate an AccountGenesis-only complete index; use an exclusive index_path and fail closed on foreign, incomplete or wrong-domain inventory. Do not modify generic production code in this design iteration.

cross_authority_rotation_attack.precondition: Catalog secret C and AccountGenesis secret A use different service_name and storage prefix but the same index_path
cross_authority_rotation_attack.mechanism: AccountGenesis can enumerate Catalog storage_key, receive None from its service-local get_password lookup, and unregister the foreign inventory entry
cross_authority_rotation_attack.closed_by_contract: Dedicated AccountGenesis-only index_path plus rejection of foreign inventory before rotation

generic_secret_storage_reuse.catalog_preservation: AccountGenesis storage operation MUST NOT make accepted M0.12 authority unavailable

authentication_algorithm.rationale: The verifier is Core-owned, persistence is locally untrusted, and no canonical third-party/offline verification requirement exists. HMAC provides strong record authenticity with simpler custody than asymmetric signing; selection follows this threat model, not precedent alone.

alternatives.asymmetric_signatures: NOT_SELECTED: no third-party verification requirement; adds private-key lifecycle and public-key trust-root complexity without solving freshness
alternatives.other_existing_production_primitive: NOT_SELECTED: public SHA-256 chains detect corruption but do not authenticate against an attacker who can rewrite persistence
alternatives.DESIGN_BLOCKED: NOT_SELECTED: requirements suffice to select HMAC-SHA-256; domain authority/root-of-trust remains separately blocked

cryptographic_domains.environment_rule: Every preimage binds exactly one PRODUCTION or TEST authority domain; validators reject all other domains
cryptographic_domains.cross_record_substitution: MUST_FAIL: purpose, record type, authority domain and environment are authenticated and validators require the expected literal

record_authentication_coverage.canonicalization: Exact deterministic encoding MUST be specified before implementation; ambiguous encodings are forbidden
record_authentication_coverage.invariant: valid AccountGenesis MAC != authorized account creation

key_namespace.test_custody: In-memory or isolated test-only implementation using cryptohunter.account-genesis.test.v1; no production service or slots
key_namespace.coexistence_invariant: ACCOUNTGENESIS_KEYRING_INDEX MUST NOT enumerate, mutate, remove or rotate Catalog custody inventory entries; Catalog storage master-key rotation MUST NOT enumerate or mutate AccountGenesis custody inventory.

key_lifecycle.ACTIVE: May authenticate new records and verify historical records
key_lifecycle.VERIFY_ONLY: Cannot authenticate new records; continues verification of legitimate historical records
key_lifecycle.REVOKED: Cannot authenticate new records. Historical records remain cryptographically checkable but are reported as signed by a compromised/revoked key and require authenticated compromise policy; they MUST NOT be silently reclassified as never having existed.
key_lifecycle.lifecycle_root: YES: distinct AccountGenesis lifecycle root secret; Catalog lifecycle root reuse is forbidden
key_lifecycle.revocation_semantics: Revocation is prospective admission denial plus explicit compromise evidence, not destructive erasure of terminal genesis history
key_lifecycle.destructive_retirement: FORBIDDEN without a replay-safe, authenticated, freshness-preserving migration proof

historical_verification.normal_rotation: REQUIRED: legitimate historical genesis facts remain verifiable via VERIFY_ONLY material
historical_verification.revocation: Historical bytes and provenance remain verifiable and visible with REVOKED status; authorization/trust response is a separate policy decision

key_rotation.authority_key_rotation: Creates new independent ACTIVE authentication material; old ACTIVE becomes VERIFY_ONLY; authenticated lifecycle generation and freshness head advance
key_rotation.storage_master_key_rotation: Only re-encrypts custody values; MUST NOT change authority key_id, lifecycle state, record MAC, or authority generation

freshness_lineage.commitment: One canonical authenticated document binds every semantic head, authority/environment domains, schema version and anchor generation; omitted or independently advanced heads are forbidden
closure: PREPARED and COMMITTED are distinct authenticated states

anchor_models.A_one_unified_lineage: NOT_SELECTED: obscures independent semantic heads and complicates diagnosis
anchor_models.B_namespaced_slots: NOT_SELECTED: independent writes permit torn cross-lineage closure
anchor_models.C_atomic_multi_lineage_document: SELECTED: one AccountGenesis-only custody slot atomically replaces a canonical document covering all heads
anchor_models.D_remote_TPM_monotonic: NOT_REQUIRED_BY_CURRENT_THREAT_BOUNDARY; future strengthening must preserve this contract
anchor_models.anchor_authentication: HMAC-SHA-256 under a dedicated AccountGenesis anchor key plus opaque production custody; custody alone is insufficient because canonical bytes and domain/key identity require authentication
anchor_models.monotonicity: Comparison anchor, not hardware monotonic storage

anchor_atomicity.protocol: verify current local closure and anchor -> commit local transaction -> publish complete external anchor document -> re-read and compare
anchor_atomicity.crash_after_local_commit_before_publish: FAIL_CLOSED / recovery required; never remint, publish stale account, or treat COMMITTED as uncommitted

anchor_mismatch_semantics.local_greater_than_anchor: Ambiguous between interrupted publication and anchor rollback; FAIL_CLOSED
anchor_mismatch_semantics.local_less_than_anchor: Evidence consistent with DB rollback or coordinated corruption; FAIL_CLOSED
anchor_mismatch_semantics.automatic_repair: FORBIDDEN unless a future deterministic authenticated direction proof external to both compared states is frozen
anchor_mismatch_semantics.reason: A valid local MAC proves authenticity, not which side is freshest; direction cannot be inferred safely from the two values alone

rollback_threat_boundary.selected: A. same local anti-rollback boundary as Catalog, instantiated independently
rollback_threat_boundary.rationale: Current local/Core-owned topology has no canonical remote or TPM requirement; stronger protection remains an additive future requirement, while the exact non-protection is explicit

machine_binding.production: HWID-bound KeyringSecretStorage master key; mismatch makes custody unavailable
machine_binding.security_property: Device binding protects local custody access but is not an account identity or remote rollback proof

migration.default: Cross-machine use MUST fail closed until a separately authorized export/import protocol transfers authority keys, lifecycle, complete journal closure and freshness state atomically
migration.root_account_recovery: Must not be inferred from copying the DB or changing HWID; domain authority/root proof remains separate

backup_restore.DB_same_machine: Accepted only when restored closure exactly equals retained authenticated anchor; older/newer mismatch fails closed
backup_restore.DB_new_machine: Fails closed: missing/mismatched HWID-bound custody and anchor; requires authenticated migration
backup_restore.keyring_backup_only: Fails closed against unequal/missing local authenticated closure
backup_restore.DB_and_keyring: Coherent historical rollback is NOT_DETECTED within the selected threat boundary; operational restore MUST use an external authenticated migration/recovery proof

CAS_compatibility.rule: Every transition binds current identity, generation and predecessor; serialization compares expected authenticated heads before one local atomic commit and then publishes the complete anchor
CAS_compatibility.semantic_owner: CAS prevents races but does not decide semantic authorization

restart_order_rule: No resolver publication or semantic recovery precedes successful lifecycle, closure and freshness checks.

exact_type_gating.production_constructor_rule: Future production AccountGenesis authority MUST accept only exact approved production custody/store/anchor types
exact_type_gating.note: Exact approved class identities are implementation-time names; the exact-type semantic gate is frozen now

authority_boundary.security_substrate: Authenticates and freshness-protects exact records only
authority_boundary.custody_owner: AccountGenesis-specific security component; exact component NOT_FROZEN
authority_boundary.freshness_owner: AccountGenesis-specific security component; exact component NOT_FROZEN

result.scope: Security contract only; no production authority implementation
